response.sql: SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS average_length, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS average_daily_rental_rate FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating;

assumptions.assumption: Films costing exactly 20.99 to replace count as expensive.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff excludes films costing exactly 20.99 to replace.
